sm-nuget 1.0.0 — .NET Package Intelligence Suite by Slash Mark IT Solutions
30 advanced tools for NuGet supply-chain security, governance, dependency analysis and upgrades.

Usage: sm-nuget <tool> [arguments] [options]

SUPPLY-CHAIN SECURITY
  security     Audit packages against the GitHub Advisory Database and get the smallest safe upgrade
  confusion    Find private package ids that also exist on nuget.org and aren't protected by source mapping
  typosquat    Flag package ids that look like popular packages (edit distance, homoglyphs, prefix tricks)
  scripts      Find build-time code in packages: MSBuild Exec/DownloadFile, inline tasks, install.ps1, native binaries
  secrets      Scan .nupkg contents for leaked keys, tokens, connection strings, private keys and local paths
  verify       Check author/repository signatures, certificates, timestamps and signer changes between versions
  provenance   Verify each package's nuspec <repository url/commit> against the real GitHub repo and tags
  sourcelink   Check Source Link, deterministic builds, embedded/symbol PDBs and compiler flags of package assemblies
  sourcemap    Generate a <packageSourceMapping> block for nuget.config from your restore graph

COMPLIANCE & GOVERNANCE
  license      Resolve licenses for the whole graph, enforce deny/allow lists, write THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES
  policy       Enforce one policy file (vulns, licenses, deprecation, health, bans, signatures) in CI
  health       0–100 health score per package: maintenance, vulnerabilities, license, metadata, TFMs
  sbom         CycloneDX 1.5 or SPDX 2.3 SBOM with hashes, licenses, dependencies and vulnerabilities

DEPENDENCY ANALYSIS
  graph        Full dependency graph per framework as a tree, Mermaid, DOT or JSON, with risky nodes highlighted
  conflicts    Find NU1605 downgrades, NU1608 out-of-range versions and cross-project mismatches; test a package before adding it
  why          Show every path through which a (transitive) package enters your build
  unused       Flag PackageReferences none o
[truncated]
